sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last six matches before that defeat. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and arrive in poor form, having won only once in their last five outings, making this a favourable fixture for the leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, travel to Eccleshall in a meeting between two in-form teams—Eccleshall have won their last two while Bridgnorth are building momentum after recent victories. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the standings, visit Wednesfield Community; Casuals are on a strong run with three consecutive wins. Bilston Town, fifth, make the trip to Foley Meir as they continue their consistent form with five wins in their last six. Struggling Widnes Town, bottom with 2 points, visit Brereton Social, who are themselves in a difficult spell having lost three of their last six. New Mills, currently mid-table, host Market Drayton Town in a clash between sides with middling form. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, with both sides looking to climb away from the lower reaches. Shawbury United, in the drop zone, face Barnton at home as they seek to end a run of five consecutive defeats. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's struggling sides. In the midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a repeat meeting.
